notes: Inbound SMB lead via self-serve sign-up. Interested in Hosted API for customer support assistant + internal FAQ search. Primary contact: Priya Shah (CTO, marigoldharbor.ai). Key topic on first call: data privacy/retention. Priya: 'We need guarantees that PII or customer prompts aren't retained longer than necessary and that end-users can opt-out.' Wants explicit answers to: 1) Do you persist full prompts? 2) What is default log retention window for Hosted API? 3) Is there an API-level opt-out or per-tenant mode that disables retention? 4) Are cached prefixes or KV caches stored centrally where Redwood could access them? 5) Is there a path for deletion / redaction of prompts and logs? Legal wants short retention (30-90 days) and ability to opt-out of logging for sensitive routes. They asked about anonymization/hashing as intermediary option. We discussed Redwood's hosted privacy options at high level (default retention, opt-out via metadata flag, enterprise-grade deletion for Private/Dedicated). Priya asked for a crisp one-pager and an example API header to disable retention for a request. Action: prepare sample header, link to Hosted privacy FAQ, retention SLA, and short POC template.
